functionalVerification.details: All M0-M7 backend, MCP, and Android companion modules implemented and verified via automated unit and cross-system integration suites.

securityVerification.details: Strict separation of authentication and authorization; idempotency replay protection; revision/evidence/policy digest validation; secret redaction in audit timeline.

identityAndAuthorization.details: LocalIdentityProvider (100% offline standalone) and PocketBaseIdentityProvider (activity_users) verified; monitor:read tokens strictly blocked from governance actions (HTTP 403); service and coding agent identities blocked from human approvals.

stateMachineCompatibility.details: Backward-compatible with active Task Contracts; Emergency Stop state machine (STOP_REQUESTED -> STOP_DISPATCHED -> STOP_CONFIRMED/STOP_FAILED/STOP_UNCONFIRMED) fences stale worker epochs cleanly.

databaseCompatibility.details: Additive schema migrations on SQLite WAL (dev-workflow.db) preserve existing active sessions, task contracts, and Zettly relations without destructive schema resets.

integrationCompatibility.details: Zettly Todo/Draw synchronization, PocketBase activity_users identity, and Central Gateway default-deny policy guard (pb_*, infra_*, notify_*) verified; legacy activity_tasks and deleted Factory permanently excluded.

mobileCompatibility.details: Release APK verified (66,807,604 bytes, SHA-256: 3867aae95599e6c5cb85d8724a2a2f9e2ba0d1007da13d21986d01f0238d5800). Live Xiaomi Pad 6 hardware (model 23043RP34G / pipa, 1800x2880 @ 400dpi) verified via wireless ADB.

rollbackReadiness.details: Documented < 60-second rollback procedure via pre-canary SQLite WAL snapshot, git revision pin, and managed/restart-devices.cjs.

activeSessionSafety.details: Inspected live sessions on http://100.77.138.14:3100 (including active clinic session on HELLOWORLD). Zero remote server mutations or unapproved fleet restarts performed.

sensitiveDataScanning.details: Public-safety sanitizer and audit log redaction verified; zero hardcoded tokens, private IPs in OSS modules, or committed Android keystores.
